Schnittstelle Either<L,R>

Typparameter:
L - the left value type
R - the right value type
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Appliable2<Either.µ,L,R>, Bindable<Either.µ,R>, Copyable<Either<L,R>>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Either.µ,R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Either.µ,L,R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Either.µ>, Mappable<Either.µ,R>, Supplier<R>, Swappable<Either<R,L>, L, R>, Transmogrifyable<Either<L,R>>, Unwindable<Either<L,R>>, Value<R>, XorValue<L,R>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Either.Left, Either.Right
public sealed interface Either<L,R> extends Mappable<Either.µ,R>, Appliable2<Either.µ,L,R>, Bindable<Either.µ,R>, Swappable<Either<R,L>, L, R>, Copyable<Either<L,R>>, Unwindable<Either<L,R>>, Transmogrifyable<Either<L,R>>, XorValue<L,R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Either.µ,L,R>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<Either.µ,R> permits Either.Left<L,R>, Either.Right<L,R>

A disjoint union (sum type) that holds either a value of type L (left) or a value of type R (right).

Commonly used to model alternative outcomes (e.g., error or success) without throwing exceptions. This implementation is right‑biased: mapping and flatMap operations act on the right value, while leaving the left value unchanged.

Evaluation semantics:

  • The active side (left vs right) is determined eagerly at construction time or when using monadic operations such as flatMap(Function).
  • The payload stored in Left and Right is represented lazily via Supplier and is evaluated when accessors such as getLeft(), getRight(), map(Function), mapLeft(Function), unwind(), Object.equals(Object), Object.hashCode(), or Object.toString() are invoked.

Contract: unless stated otherwise, inputs must not be null and results must not be null. Lazy evaluation is used internally via suppliers; unwinding methods evaluate stored suppliers.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • flatten

      static <L,R> Either<L,R> flatten(@NonNull org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<Either.µ, ? extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<? extends Either.µ, L, R>, ? extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher2<? extends Either.µ, L, R>> wrapped)

      Flattens a nested Either by one level.

      Semantics:

      • If the outer Either is a Left, its content (an inner higher-kinded Either) is narrowed and returned.
      • If the outer Either is a Right, its content (an inner higher-kinded Either) is narrowed and returned.

      Typparameter:
      L - the left value type
      R - the right value type
      Parameter:

      the flattened Either

    • flatMap

      default <S> @NonNull Either<L,S> flatMap(@NonNull Function<? super R, ? extends org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher1<? extends Either.µ, S>> transformation)

      Monadic flatMap (right‑biased): applies the given transformation (monadic bind) to the right value. Left values pass through unchanged.

      Laziness:

      • When this is a Left, flatMap returns the same left value without evaluating any payload or invoking transformation.
      • When this is a Right, flatMap eagerly evaluates the current right payload and applies transformation in order to obtain the resulting Either. In other words, the choice of left/right in the result is made at flatMap-time, not deferred.
      • Any laziness of the resulting payload depends on the implementation of transformation.

      Angegeben von:
      flatMap in Schnittstelle Bindable<L,R>
      Typparameter:
      S - the resulting right type
      Parameter:
      transformation - right‑side flatMap function; must not be null
      Gibt zurück:
      the bound Either
      Seit:
      1.0.0

    • unwind

      @UnwindingOperation default @NonNull Either<L,R> unwind()

      Unwinds (materializes) the current value on the active side and returns a strict Either. Left evaluates its supplier and returns Left(value); Right evaluates its supplier and returns Right(value).

      After unwinding, the resulting Either no longer defers evaluation of its payload: subsequent calls to accessors or structural operations will work on already-materialized values for both sides.

      Angegeben von:
      unwind in Schnittstelle Unwindable<L>
      Gibt zurück:
      a strict Either with the same side/value
      Seit:
      1.0.0
